hints.title: Subtree Carpooling
hints.text: All representatives residing inside a subtree must cross the single edge connecting that subtree to its parent to reach capital node 0.

hints.title: Seat Capacity Calculation
hints.text: For a subtree containing c total representatives, the number of cars needed to travel across its parent edge is ceil(c / seats).

hints.title: Post-Order Summation
hints.text: Perform a recursive post-order traversal from node 0. Accumulate cars needed across each edge, ignoring the root node.

hints.title: Subtree Representative Counting Implementation

variables: n: number of cities in tree
complexity.notes: Single post-order depth traversal touches each city and edge once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Tracking vehicle locations and seating arrangements individually leads to exponential branch exploration.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary space for tree graph and recursion stack.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models edge fuel cost as ceil(subtree_people / seats) using post-order tree accumulation.
